expectations.evidence: Explicitly makes this call under 'Structural': "Too granular, too early: kubernetes / python / go as separate channels before there's any traffic fragments the few active people across empty rooms. Start with #general + #help + #showcase; fork tech-specific channels only once one topic hits real volume in #general (e.g. sustained weekly threads)." It names a concrete three-channel opening surface, gives the fragmentation rationale (few active people spread across empty rooms), and supplies a graduation trigger for adding back the tech-specific rooms. It also recommends deferring #jobs entirely
